description: Returns real-time AIS positions, speed, heading, ETA, and dock status for all active WSF vessels. Use for "where is the ferry now?", vessel tracking, or checking if a vessel is in service. Position data may lag by 30–60 seconds. Many fields are null for vessels not currently operating.
name: wsdot_get_vessel_locations

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSF Ferry API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSF rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Optional notice when no vessel data is available. Absent on normal results.

vessels.description: All WSF vessels with real-time position data.

items.description: Real-time position and status for one WSF vessel.

arrivingTerminalId.description: Terminal the vessel is heading toward.

atDock.description: True when the vessel is docked at a terminal.

departingTerminalId.description: Terminal the vessel is departing from.

eta.description: Estimated arrival time at the destination terminal.

inService.description: Whether the vessel is currently in service.

leftDock.description: Time the vessel last left the dock.

opRouteAbbrev.description: Abbreviations of routes this vessel operates on.

timestamp.description: AIS data timestamp — indicates position data age.

title: Get Vessel Locations
